description: Shrink-only architecture graph ledger. Add an entry with a reason only after an architecture review; remove entries when the code shrinks. Allowed component edges carry kinds (include/link) so a link permission cannot widen the include graph beyond check_plane_isolation. A modules -> modules include permission outside check_plane_isolation.MODULE_ALLOWED must carry sources: [preprocessor_closure], the explicit provenance marker for edges only the real preprocessor closure can see. When the gate runs with --compile-commands, component edges and forbidden headers are judged on the real preprocessor closure, and text-only edges from uncompiled branches are still kept and judged (fail-closed). Residuals: add_edge_test macro-generated test targets are folded; cmake/ helper macros and edge_add_contract are not expanded; cycle detection is capped at 1000 nodes and fails instead of skipping; generated headers (contracts/build paths) are not indexed; a forbidden_headers files rule can be pointed at an unrelated file, so review of ledger edits remains the control. Ledger changes require the same architecture review as code.

shared_surfaces.reason: The public include/ tree and foundation/include are shared dependency surfaces, not implementation components. The current ROOT<->edge_io mutual include is a facade split (shared port headers vs aggregating SDK headers), not a component cycle.

conditional_handling: All if()/else() branches are parsed and merged. An edge that exists on only one platform still has to obey this matrix, so conditionals fail closed instead of disappearing.
